title: Enistere Capability Overlay v1
description: Declarative overlay applied by the Factory engine to compose a capability onto a starter baseline. Overlays never carry scripts, hooks or free-form commands: every operation is interpreted by the engine through a known, deterministic renderer.

capability.description: Registered capability id (must match the directory).

target.description: Registered starter id (must match the directory).

files.description: Files or directories copied verbatim from the overlay payload into the generated app. Copying onto an existing file fails unless the entry declares overwrite: true.

source.description: Path relative to the overlay directory, under files/.

destination.description: Path relative to the generated app directory.

overwrite.description: Declared replacement of a baseline file (file entries only).

environment.description: Environment variables appended to the app .env.example.

integrations.description: Central integration requests rendered by the engine. Unknown kinds are rejected.

verification.description: Argv arrays executed from the app directory by the generated verify script.

contract.description: Optional public-contract expectations verified against artifacts generated from the composed application.

openapiOperations.description: OperationIds contributed by this capability. Supported only by the NestJS target.
